authored.prompt: Same finding, service side: which line performs the expected-version comparison only when a version was supplied?
authored.explanation: MutateAsync checks `expectedVersion is not null && board.Version != expectedVersion.Value` (06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md:73).

authored.prompt: Review finding B: a same-column move to position 99 gets a 200 and lands at the end instead of being rejected. Which line silently clamps it?
authored.explanation: RepositionCard inserts at `Math.Clamp(nextPosition, 0, _cards.Count)` (06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md:80-81); no test pins this asymmetry.

authored.prompt: The other side of finding B: a negative move position is a 400. Which line in the aggregate rejects it before any card is removed?
authored.explanation: Board.MoveCard calls `Guard.NonNegative(position, ...)` at line 90, after the target lookup and before removal (06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md:78-79).
